reviews.frank_statement: ClayCode/FRANK should represent effect intent and required capabilities while actual external execution remains behind an opaque, externally validated permit/capability gateway.
reviews.counterhypothesis: A compiler could treat declared capability names or inferred effects as sufficient execution authority, simplifying the runtime boundary without observable safety loss.
reviews.falsifier: A matched executable design in which inferred/declared capability metadata alone safely authorizes effects across forgery, delegation, stale/revoked-resource and replay cases without ambient-authority escalation.
